Class ConversionTck

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.ConversionTck
public abstract class ConversionTck extends AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
Conversions: casts, boxing and unboxing, primitive widening of arguments and of requested return types, and values discarded after they are converted.

A backend runs these tests by extending this class and implementing AbstractByteCodeWriterTck.write(io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.ObjectDef).

Since:
2.3
